summary: Iteration 21: tested server-side PRO blindatura, teaser ('assaggio') recipes, admin coupon/VIP panel, paywall + trial, and password reset flow. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass (new file test_iter21_paywall.py). Frontend: all requested flows pass (anon lock icons + teaser CTA, anon paywall on maestro/diagnosi, admin crown + grant/revoke, admin no-paywall + unlocked recipes, non-PRO paywall with sub/trial buttons, trial-1h activation with countdown banner and unlocked content, forgot-password confirmation, reset screen with invalid-token error). One real UI defect found: the IntroGuide modal renders over the ?reset= screen and its Radix overlay blocks all clicks until dismissed.

minor.issue: Uses update_one without upsert and returns {ok:true} even when the email has no entitlement document (silent no-op); consider 404 or explicit 'not found' flag.
Returns revoked rows (pro:false) in a list labelled 'ACCESSI ATTIVI' in the UI — cosmetic/data-labelling mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /?reset=<token> renders reset-screen but IntroGuide dialog also opens on every load; its Radix DialogOverlay (z-50, pointer-events on body) intercepts all clicks so reset-password/reset-submit are unusable until intro is closed. Also intro is shown on EVERY page load (no localStorage persistence).

issues: The teaser card fills the modal; base ingredients promised in the copy are not visible without scrolling — consider showing the base ingredient list above the lock card.

action_items: Do not render <IntroGuide /> when resetToken is present in App.js (and persist intro dismissal in localStorage) so the password-reset screen is usable.
Optional: make /api/admin/revoke report when the email had no entitlement; label the admin list 'Accessi' or filter inactive rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1781 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, recipes, maestro/capo, billing/admin).
require_pro/require_admin correctly depend on current_user so anonymous requests get 401 and non-PRO/non-admin get 403 — verified end-to-end.
_teaser_recipe strips procedure/notes/work_phases/extra_ingredients/costing and sets locked:true; no _id leakage in any response tested.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (1 blocking overlay bug on reset screen)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted entitlements for test_vip_iter21@example.com and vip_ui_iter21@example.com. Trial was activated for fornaio@mikilab.de during testing; its entitlement document was DELETED afterwards, so fornaio is back to non-PRO with trial available.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest tests/test_iter21_paywall.py` for paywall/blindatura regression. Note: /api/maestro/vision requires body {mode:'difetti'|'ingredienti', image_base64, lang}. Trial is one-shot per email; delete the entitlements doc in Mongo to re-test the trial UI. On the frontend, close the intro modal (intro-close-btn) before any interaction — it appears on every load.
rca_of_the_issue: App.js renders <IntroGuide /> unconditionally and IntroGuide opens itself in a useEffect on mount, with no persistence. When the URL contains ?reset=<token>, both ResetPassword (z-[80]) and the Radix intro Dialog (z-50 overlay + body pointer-events lock) mount together; Radix's modal semantics block pointer events outside its own content, so the visually-on-top reset form cannot be clicked.
